questions.question: Which language should the API use?
questions.rationale: The user explicitly requires Python and Pydantic validation before any LLM call.

questions.question: Which Python API framework should the backend use?

options.label: FastAPI
options.description: Async-friendly API framework with strong Pydantic integration.

options.label: Flask
options.description: Lightweight framework for a minimal API.

options.label: Django REST Framework
options.description: Full-featured framework for APIs with built-in application structure.

questions.rationale: The framework was not specified; FastAPI is recommended because Pydantic validation is a core requirement.

questions.question: Confirm or add API requirements (Python/Pydantic validation before any LLM call; local Ollama; exactly three roles—generator, reviewer, repair/executor; Azure-only operations; allowlisted Terraform modules invoked as tools; deterministic config generation; reflective review; static checks; saved plan; policy checks and approval gate; apply requires an approval token; classify repairable errors and stop after five attempts).
questions.rationale: These functional and safety requirements were explicitly provided by the user.

questions.question: Which data stores are required?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Do not persist generated configurations, plans, or review artifacts.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Persist generated configuration artifacts, saved Terraform plans, and policy/review results.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Persist structured workflow, approval, and audit metadata.

questions.rationale: A saved plan is required; Azure Blob Storage is inferred for persisted plan and run artifacts. No relational database was specified.

questions.question: Should users sign in to use the application's API features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require users to sign in to access API features.

options.label: No
options.description: Do not require user sign-in for API features.

questions.rationale: The approval-token requirement is recorded as a separate apply safety control; user sign-in was not specified.
